messages.text: I’ll read the observer contract and frozen protocol, then build the instrumentation and driver as separate files. The existing geometry, segmentation, transport runner and tolerances will remain unchanged.

The coordinator’s diagnostic compile now passes. I’m testing the Python checks that require exact float32 agreement for every saved cell, reconcile the independently accumulated native totals, and keep unassigned energy distinct from output rounding. The analysis uses one shared bootstrap across both geometries and all H/A/U views.

**LAR-GAP10K-SoftEng-step-observer is frozen**, against `81674f8630ab29c8462d5b88226000e07a2d0641`.

Six new files implement independent step/event accounting, steering, transport/readback, comparison and tests. Existing geometry, segmentation, transport and analysis sources are unchanged.

- Records independently accumulated A, successful-cell S and unassigned U.
- Enforces weight 1, Birks 0, positive-edep filtering, non-optical policy and `FE_TONEAREST`.
- Requires exact saved-cell `float32(S_MeV/1000)` agreement and precision-derived event closure.
- Checks original SD error correspondence and optional full retained-run replay.
- Preserves the fixed tail threshold, shared H/A/U bootstrap and joint 84-variable width covariance.

**Checks:** 35 pure tests pass; `git diff --check` passes. Coordinator diagnostic C++ compile passed. No native events ran in this assignment.

After committing clean sources:

```sh
set -e
work=build/lar-gap10k/observed
ref=../nodd-lar-10k-response/build/lar10k-resume
native_report=build/lar-gap10k/corrected/native-comparison.json

software/env/run.sh cmake -S software/analysis/lar_gap \
  -B "$work/library" -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
software/env/run.sh cmake --build "$work/library" --parallel 3

barrel_library=../nodd-lar-geant4-placement/build/lar-placement/factories/libnODDLArBarrelPrototype.dylib
endcap_library=../nodd-lar-geant4-placement/build/lar-placement/factories/libnODDLArEndcapPrototype.dylib
audit_library="$ref/audit/libnODDLArResponseAudit.dylib"
observer_library="$work/library/libnODDLArStepObserver.dylib"

observe() {
  software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/observed_transport.py run \
    --sample "$1" --events "$2" --threads "$3" --output "$4" \
    --native-report "$native_report" \
    --geometry-library "$barrel_library" --geometry-library "$endcap_library" \
    --audit-library "$audit_library" --observer-library "$observer_library" \
    --reserve-gib 30

  if [ "$#" -eq 5 ]; then
    software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/observed_transport.py audit \
      --sample "$1" --run "$4" --retained-run "$5"
  else
    software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/observed_transport.py audit \
      --sample "$1" --run "$4"
  fi
}

for variant in standard candidate; do
  if [ "$variant" = standard ]; then
    sample="$ref/sample"
  else
    sample=build/lar-gap10k/corrected/sample400
  fi

  observe "$sample" 24 1 "$work/$variant/serial24"
  observe "$sample" 24 12 "$work/$variant/mt24"

  software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/observed_transport.py controls \
    --serial "$work/$variant/serial24" --mt "$work/$variant/mt24" \
    --output "$work/$variant/controls.json"

  observe "$sample" 100 12 "$work/$variant/pilot100"
done

observe "$ref/sample" 10000 12 "$work/standard/production12" "$ref/production12"
observe build/lar-gap10k/corrected/sample400 10000 12 \
  "$work/candidate/production12" build/lar-gap10k/corrected/production12
```

After all gates pass:

```sh
plot_python=[redacted]

"$plot_python" -B software/analysis/lar_gap/observed_compare.py analyze \
  --standard "$work/standard/production12" \
  --candidate "$work/candidate/production12" \
  --bootstrap 1000 --seed 13001000 --output "$work/comparison"

MPLCONFIGDIR="$work/mpl-cache" "$plot_python" -B \
  software/analysis/lar_gap/observed_compare.py plot \
  --summary "$work/comparison/summary.json" --output "$work/figures"
```

All output directories must be fresh. Complete A/E accounting does not validate the unresolved cell-readout classification.
